name: Chinese Chess · Free Play
invite_help: Send an invite to start a two-player match.
offline_help: Your board is kept. Play resumes when both players reconnect.
play_help: Select your piece, then any empty point or opposing piece.
choose_piece: Select one of your pieces first.
resign_help: Your opponent will win this round. You can still play again.
rematch_wait: Waiting for the other player to accept.
undo_help_wait: Play pauses until your opponent responds or you cancel.
undo_help_incoming: Accept to restore the board and let your opponent move again.
undo_unavailable: You can’t undo a move right now.
undo_pending: Respond to the current undo request first.
illegal_move: Choose an empty point or an opposing piece.
retry: That action didn’t go through. Try again.
